hero.title: Full-Stack .NET / Angular Engineer
hero.description: Full-Stack Engineer with {{anneesExperience}} years of experience in designing and developing robust and scalable web applications within the .NET and Angular ecosystem, with a strong mastery of modern architectures and Azure Cloud.

about.title: ABOUT
about.description: Possessing strong adaptability and versatility, I manage the entire web application lifecycle, from initial user needs analysis through to technical deployment. I am an expert in the .NET and Angular ecosystems, leveraging a deep understanding of modern architectures (Microservices, Clean Architecture) and Azure Cloud. I focus on delivering high-performance solutions that directly address and fulfill core business requirements.

henner.description: Implementation of back-end solutions intended to replace the ESB, focusing on a modular architecture, maintainability, and exhaustive unit test coverage.

push_notification.name: Push Notification Project
push_notification.details: Batch job for sending notifications to mobile applications.
push_notification.context: Design and development of a notification batch process aimed at automating the retrieval and update of database (DB) data, as well as sending notifications to mobile applications (Android and iOS) via the Airship third-party service.

realization.tache1: Structuring the project around a solid architecture to ensure optimal separation of responsibilities and maintainability.
realization.tache2: Writing and execution of SQL migration scripts to create and initialize configuration tables in the database.
realization.tache3: Development of repositories (notification and configuration) in the infrastructure layer, in order to implement operations for retrieving and updating unsent notifications and managing configuration parameters from different database tables.
realization.tache4: Development of business logic to determine the notification type (singular/plural) and to build CSV files (payloads) compliant with Airship API requirements.
realization.tache5: Implementation of a service to make calls to Airship APIs via HttpWebRequest and ensuring JSON flow management (serialization/deserialization) to retrieve static lists, update data, and send notifications.
realization.tache6: Setting up log and error management to ensure error traceability and facilitate maintenance.

ring_central.name: RingCentral Project
ring_central.details: Webhook that processes emails from RingCentral in real time.
ring_central.context: Design and development of a Webhook in .NET 6 within a Microservices architecture for the real-time processing of user messages and email attachments.

realization.tache1: Development of REST APIs to allow managers to retrieve email attachments, get details of a specific message, and list all messages for an agent across all instances.
realization.tache2: Optimization of response time by implementing parallel calls to all RingCentral instances for synchronous and fast data collection.
realization.tache3: Specific authentication management per instance to guarantee security and segmentation of access to RingCentral data.
realization.tache4: Data modeling and definition of DTOs for object serialization.
realization.tache5: Integration of AutoMapper to automate and reliable mapping operations.
realization.tache6: Use of FluentValidation for clear and decoupled business validation.
realization.tache7: Centralization of HTTP requests in dedicated repositories, relying on HttpClientFactory's dependency injection.
realization.tache8: Execution of unit tests (xUnit) with dependency mocking (Moq), and result verification using FluentAssertions.
realization.tache9: Deployment on the staging environment and application of SonarQube rules to ensure code quality.

broker.name: Courtier Project
broker.details: Redesign of task management within the Web API project.
broker.context: Redesign of a task management system to replace the existing one within the Web API project.

realization.tache1: Design and modeling of the database, with definition of the relational schema and development of DB migration scripts via FluentMigrator.
realization.tache2: Development of a dedicated repository for task management, including creation, modification, retrieval, and multi-criteria search operations with added sorting and pagination features as well as the management of associated comments.
realization.tache3: Integration of the repository via the Unit of Work pattern into services to replace calls to the old system.
realization.tache4: Code structuring around models and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs), with use of AutoMapper to ensure mapping between the different layers.
realization.tache5: Creation and updating of unit tests with xUnit, ensuring the security of developments and non-regression of the code.
realization.tache6: Functional and technical validation of the APIs with execution of complete scenarios and verification of edge cases.
realization.tache7: Contribution to the deployment and continuous integration of the solution via GitLab CI/CD.

migration.name: .NET Migration
migration.context: Migration of over 100 interdependent projects (SDKs, APIs, Services) from .NET 6 to .NET 8, including the development of an internal tool to automate and secure the process.

realization.tache1: Development of a console application to automate the migration of .NET 6 projects to .NET 8.
realization.tache2: Analysis of dependencies between projects and grouping into coherent migration batches to minimize conflicts

tache3.title: Complete automation of the migration pipeline:
tache3.sous_tache1: Automatic creation of a dedicated Git branch for each project.
tache3.sous_tache6: Automatic execution of build and unit tests.
tache3.sous_tache7: Generation and update of an Excel report.
tache3.sous_tache8: Centralization of logs to ensure traceability.
tache3.sous_tache9: Automatic push of changes to the created branch of each migrated project if its migration is validated

realization.tache4: Manual migration of projects containing build or unit test errors, including replacement of obsolete methods and correction of incompatibilities
realization.tache5: Deployment of migrated projects to the Nexus server (Nuget-Beta version) for integration and reuse in other projects.

mapgears.description: Design and development of a web application for satellite image visualization.

sentinel.name: Sentinel-2 Visualization
sentinel.context: Development and design of a web solution to easily visualize recent and past geographic data on a dynamic map using a set of geospatial images periodically retrieved from the Sentinel-2 satellite.
sentinel.details: Web application for visualizing Sentinel-2 satellite images.

realization.tache1: Design of an interactive mapping application.
realization.tache2: Communication with Sentinel-2 via a REST API to retrieve satellite images corresponding to a defined area of interest, over a time interval and refresh frequency specified by the user.
realization.tache3: Downloading satellite images from Sentinel-2 and processing the associated geospatial data.
realization.tache4: Storage and management of geographic data in a PostgreSQL database with the PostGIS extension to perform spatial and raster analysis.
realization.tache5: Interactive display of data on an OpenLayers map, with the ability to zoom in, zoom out, and move around the map, allowing detailed exploration of the areas of interest.
realization.tache6: Writing technical and functional documentation, including the creation of UML diagrams and the drafting of the specifications.
realization.tache7: Integration of GDAL/OGR libraries to manipulate geographic data with precision and efficiency.
realization.tache8: Integration of MapServer for dynamic rendering of geospatial images on a web map, enabling efficient display of spatial data layers.
